title: Rename run.rs to run/mod.rs with no behavior change
summary: Job R1 of the structure pass: move crates/athena-core/src/run.rs to run/mod.rs unchanged, so the `run` module path is unchanged and nothing needs re-exporting. The audience is the owner and verifier applying the section 5 proof. The only text edits are the two `include_str!` paths in the test module at run.rs lines 3334 and 3359, which need one more `../` because the file is one directory deeper. This is not an import line, so the report must name it as a deliberate exception.

defaults_applied.how: The test list and the full test run show the module still works after the move.
cargo test, clippy and fmt are required to pass.
The change is only the rename plus the two path fixes.
The criteria check an identical test list and a passing suite, not that the file exists.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: R0 (20261026-232420-ctt9) has landed, so the run.rs being moved includes its new characterization test. The producer works on the base that has it.
The listed Files omit docs/design/structure-pass.md. Section 5 rule 7 allows a done-pointer there, but the request does not ask for one, so I treat it as unlikely.
The `include_str!` path fix is unavoidable. Without it the crate does not compile, so it counts as part of the rename.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/run.rs no longer exists and crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs holds its text. `git diff -M` shows it as a rename. The only changed lines are the two `include_str!` paths (athena.toml and defaults.toml in the test module's `repo()`), which gain one `../` because the file is one level deeper. The report lists these two lines as the exception to the rule that only imports change.

`pub mod run;` in lib.rs and all `run::` paths in crates/ are unchanged. The report lists the Grep for `run::` and for `run.rs` over crates/ with the file counts before and after, and says why the `run.rs` hits (introspect.rs, code_health.rs, verify.rs, reading.rs, display.rs, routing.rs comment) are fixture strings or prose that do not depend on the file existing.

Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` before and after the change. The test names are identical, with the count reported. Run `cargo test --locked`, which passes, including the run-level tests and run_pin_tests.
`cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` are clean, and no `#[allow]` is added.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying run.rs became run/mod.rs with no behavior change. `git diff --stat` lists only the rename, CHANGELOG.md, and optionally the structure-pass doc pointer.

out_of_scope: Splitting any code out of run.rs into submodules (R2 onward).
Fixing the minor findings on R0 (duplicated helpers, the misplaced comment).
Any change to the gh.rs jobs.
departures: Higher pass probability than the reference. The change is a pure rename, but the include_str! path edit is easy to miss and needs a clear report.
